title: Electrospun Zn-cobimetinib-levofloxacin-PVA/PVP nanofibers for skin-targeted anticancer and antimicrobial applications

Electrospun Zn-coordinated PVA/PVP nanofibers simultaneously suppress skin cancer cells and microbial pathogens (bacterial and fungi), providing a multifunctional platform for therapeutic wound dressings.
